lead: One button that opens a list of actions and reports the one chosen: "Assign to…", "Insert a reply…", "Add a follower…", where nothing stays selected afterwards (a [Select](/select) would hold a value; a menu holds none). For a main action with related ones, see [SplitButton](/split-button).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `items` fill the menu and `onSelect` gets the key of the chosen one.
usage.label: Assign to

variants.title: Looks
variants.description: It is a Button: `variant`, `color`, `size`, `radius`, `fullWidth`, `startContent` and `loading` are its.

items.title: Separators, danger, disabled
items.description: An item is `danger` or `disabled`; `{ type: "separator" }` is a line between items.
items.label: Row actions

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: MenuButton is Button + Menu and has no slot of its own: its look comes from the theme styles of those components.
